carrying_poles.name: Carrying Poles
carrying_poles.observation: A springy pole across the shoulder lets one carrier trot with two baskets of water or grain.

river_craft.observation: Hollowed logs driven by paddles run the river both ways; the current becomes a road.

sledges_travois.name: Sledges and Travois
sledges_travois.observation: Loads dragged on trailing poles or a runner sledge cross snow, grass and mud that would break a carrier's back.

down_the_line_exchange.name: Down-the-line Exchange
down_the_line_exchange.observation: Flint, obsidian and shell pass hand to hand between neighbours until they reach people who never saw the source.

load_lashing_knots.name: Load-lashing Knots
load_lashing_knots.observation: A few trusted hitches hold a bundle tight on a back or a raft and let go with one pull.

route_food_caches.name: Route Food Caches
route_food_caches.observation: Dried food buried at known points lets a party travel light and eat on the way home.

portage_paths.name: Portage Paths
portage_paths.observation: Cleared paths let a crew shoulder the boat around the falls and across to the next water.

skis_snowshoes.name: Skis and Snowshoes
skis_snowshoes.observation: Broad frames and long runners keep hunters on top of deep snow while the game flounders.

brushwood_trackways.name: Brushwood Trackways
brushwood_trackways.observation: Mats of cut brushwood laid over bog and soft ground keep feet and loads out of the mire.

load_backframes.name: Load Backframes
load_backframes.observation: A lashed wooden frame on the back carries firewood, hides and pots too bulky for any basket.

boundary_exchange_sites.name: Boundary Exchange Places
boundary_exchange_sites.observation: Partners from both sides meet at a known stone on the boundary, trade, and go home without entering each other's camps.

reed_bundle_boats.name: Reed-bundle Boats
reed_bundle_boats.observation: Reeds bound in tight bundles and coated with bitumen float cargo through marsh and shallow river.

rollers_and_runners.name: Rollers and Runners
rollers_and_runners.observation: Logs laid under a heavy trunk or stone let a dozen people move what fifty could not lift.

salt_shell_routes.name: Salt and Shell Routes
salt_shell_routes.observation: Salt cakes and bright shell travel regular paths inland, and the salt keeps meat through the lean months.

river_landings.name: River Landings
river_landings.observation: Cleared and staked landings let boats come in to the same bank each trip and unload dry.

hide_covered_boats.name: Hide-covered Boats
hide_covered_boats.observation: Hides stretched over a wicker frame make a light boat two people can carry and six can ride.

ox_drawn_sledges.name: Ox-drawn Sledges
ox_drawn_sledges.observation: A trained ox leans into a sledge rope and hauls stone and timber that once took the whole village.

long_distance_axe_trade.name: Long-distance Axe Trade
long_distance_axe_trade.observation: Polished axes of a famous green stone pass through many hands and arrive as treasures, not tools.

paired_ox_yoke.name: Paired-ox Yoke
paired_ox_yoke.observation: A shaped beam across two necks makes a pair of oxen pull as one, on a sledge or a scratch plough.

pack_animals.observation: Donkeys under pads and panniers carry a family's load day after day and ask only grazing and water.
pack_animals.ability_reason: A donkey carries what three people could, so trips, trade and moves suddenly cost far less.

pack_saddles.name: Wooden Pack Saddles
pack_saddles.observation: A padded wooden saddle keeps panniers off the spine, so a donkey carries more for longer without sores.

plank_trackways.name: Plank Trackways
plank_trackways.observation: Split planks pegged across the wetland carry people and sledges dry-shod to the far villages.

sealed_store_doors.name: Sealed Store Doors
sealed_store_doors.observation: A lump of clay over the door latch, pressed with the keeper's seal, shows at a glance whether the store was opened.
sealed_store_doors.social_consequence: Someone now keeps count at the storehouse, and those who once took freely must ask.

plank_extended_dugouts.name: Plank-raised Dugouts
plank_extended_dugouts.observation: Planks sewn along a dugout's sides raise it high enough to carry cargo on open water.

solid_wheel_assembly.ability_reason: The first wheels turn a dragged load into a rolling one.

trade_colonies.name: Trade Outposts
trade_colonies.observation: Families settle in a distant river town to buy and ship for their kin at home.
trade_colonies.social_consequence: Some families now live among strangers for the trade, and come home speaking and dressing half like them.

cart_bed_framing.ability_reason: An ox cart moves a harvest, a house frame or a quarry's stone in one trip.

four_wheeled_wagons.name: Four-wheeled Wagons
four_wheeled_wagons.observation: Two axles under one long bed carry a load no two-wheeled cart can balance.

sail_panel_cutting.ability_reason: A square sail lets river boats go upstream on the wind instead of by the pole.

supply_groups.observation: Carriers, cooks and scouts organized as one party can keep a band fed far from home for weeks.

graded_roads.observation: Crowned and ditched road beds between towns stay firm through the rains and carry carts every season.

coastal_watercraft.ability_reason: Plank boats reach the next coast; fish, trade and news come by sea.

timber_bridges.observation: Log beams laid on timber piers carry people and pack animals over streams that once cut the road in the rains.

rope_laying.observation: Strands laid against their own twist make a long rope that holds a towed boat or a hoisted beam without unravelling.

towpaths.name: Towpaths
towpaths.observation: A beaten path along the bank lets a team haul a laden boat upstream against the current.

ferry_crossings.name: Ferry Crossings
ferry_crossings.observation: A ferryman keeps a boat at the crossing and takes people, goods and animals over for a fee.

central_storehouses.name: Central Storehouses
central_storehouses.observation: Sealed rooms hold the settlement's grain and oil, and the keeper opens them on fixed issue days.
central_storehouses.social_consequence: Grain goes into the storehouse and comes out on issue days; the keeper's tally decides who eats first in a lean spring.

onager_hybrid_teams.name: Onager-hybrid Teams
onager_hybrid_teams.observation: Crossbred asses, stronger than donkeys and tamer than wild onagers, draw the heavy four-wheeled wagons.

paved_haul_roads.name: Paved Haul Roads
paved_haul_roads.observation: Flagstones laid from the quarry to the building site carry block-laden sledges in any weather.

stone_jetty_harbors.name: Stone-jetty Harbors
stone_jetty_harbors.observation: A stone arm built out into the bay gives ships still water to load and ride out a storm.
stone_jetty_harbors.ability_reason: A sheltered harbor turns scattered beach landings into a port.
stone_jetty_harbors.social_consequence: Ships from other coasts now tie up at the jetty; harbor people learn strangers' prices, and sometimes their fevers.

wetted_track_sledging.name: Wetted-track Sledging
wetted_track_sledging.observation: Water poured before the runners on a timber track lets a gang drag a colossal stone on a sledge.

navigation_canals.name: Navigation Canals
navigation_canals.observation: Cuts between river branches let loaded boats reach fields and towns the river never touched.
navigation_canals.social_consequence: Standing canal water brings boats to the door, and with them the summer fevers.

hogging_truss_hulls.name: Hogging-truss Hulls
hogging_truss_hulls.observation: A heavy rope twisted taut from stem to stern keeps a long hull from sagging and breaking in the sea.

grain_barge_fleets.name: Grain Barge Fleets
grain_barge_fleets.observation: Barges travel the canals together at harvest and bring the outlying grain to the central stores.

donkey_caravans.name: Donkey Caravans
donkey_caravans.observation: Strings of a hundred donkeys set out each year on the same route, the same season, to the same distant markets.
donkey_caravans.ability_reason: Regular caravans make distant metals and cloth a dependable supply, not a lucky find.
donkey_caravans.social_consequence: Caravan families are away half the year; they bring back tin, cloth and news, and leave gaps at home.

standard_transport_jars.name: Standard Transport Jars
standard_transport_jars.observation: Jars of one size and shape stack in a hold and let a cargo of oil or wine be counted at a glance.

road_stations.name: Road Stations
road_stations.observation: A well, a shelter and fodder a day's march apart let travellers and animals keep going on long roads.

domesticated_mounts.observation: Horses broken to the halter pull light carts and, at last, carry a rider faster than any runner.
domesticated_mounts.ability_reason: Horses change the speed of news, trade and war.

hired_carriers.name: Hired Carriers and Boatmen
hired_carriers.observation: Carriers and boatmen agree a price for a load and a date, and are held to it before witnesses.
hired_carriers.social_consequence: Carrying becomes a paid trade; a carrier's household eats by contract rather than by kin.

spoked_wheel_assembly.ability_reason: Light spoked wheels make carts fast enough to matter on the road and in war.

island_hopping_sailing.name: Island-hopping Sailing
island_hopping_sailing.observation: Sailing from island to island, always in sight of the next landfall, ships cross seas that once ended the world.
island_hopping_sailing.ability_reason: Open-sea crossings reach whole new trading worlds.
island_hopping_sailing.social_consequence: Sailors come home with foreign wives, foreign gods and stories of towns across the water.

mountain_pack_trains.name: Mountain Pack Trains
mountain_pack_trains.observation: Pack trains cross the high passes each summer carrying tin one way and cloth the other.

merchant_quarters_abroad.name: Merchant Quarters Abroad
merchant_quarters_abroad.observation: Our merchants keep houses, stores and their own elders in a quarter of a foreign town.
merchant_quarters_abroad.social_consequence: The merchant families abroad grow rich and half foreign; at home some call them traitors, others envy them.

pilots_sea_lanes.name: Pilots and Sea Lanes
pilots_sea_lanes.observation: Pilots who know each reef and landmark guide ships along known lanes between the harbors.

sailing_calendar.name: Sailing Calendar
sailing_calendar.observation: Ships sail only in the settled months and lie up when the winter storms come.

harbor_warehouses.name: Harbor Warehouses
harbor_warehouses.observation: Rows of storehouses behind the quay hold cargo between ships and keep grain for the town.

consignment_lists.name: Consignment Lists
consignment_lists.observation: A sealed tablet listing every jar and bale travels with the cargo and is checked on arrival.

relay_team_stations.name: Relay-team Stations
relay_team_stations.observation: Fresh teams wait at stations along the main roads, so messengers and carts change animals and keep moving.

art_proposals.note: Existing paintings proposed for NEW items once the Phase 1 art test allows them; not read by the loader.
